gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds: Transfers in Street Fund 20,086 + Golf Fund 106,660 (p6) + Other Governmental Funds 14,450 (p7) = 141,196 = Total (p7); the General Fund column prints none. Detail: Street 20,086 (p15) + Golf 106,660 (p16) + Fire Equipment 14,450 (p18) = 141,196, plus the General Fund departments combining statement's transfers in between General Fund departments: Administrative 7,854, Police 14,450 (p19), Park 39,450, Pool 14,450, Library 14,450, Cemetery 14,450 (p20) = 105,104. The General Fund column nets these intra-fund departmental transfers (departments in 105,104 - out (232,810 + 7,854) = net (135,560) = statement General Fund transfers out (135,560), p6). 246,300 - 105,104 = 141,196. Both printed; no fix.

Statement: Transfers out General Fund (135,560) (p6) + Economic Development Fund (5,636) (p7) = (141,196). Detail: General Fund departments Administrative (232,810) + Police (7,854) (p19) = (240,664). Missing: the Economic Development Fund column's Transfers out (5,636) (p7); its budget schedule (p17) prints no transfer, so it is added from the statement column. Remaining -105,104 = the intra-General Fund departmental transfers that the departmental statement records gross (see transfers_in). 240,664 + 5,636 - 105,104 = 141,196 = statement total.
